opening_message: Hey I want to sign up me and my son for classes
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 34-year-old parent. You want to enroll yourself AND your 8-year-old son in classes. You want to try Adult BJJ for yourself. Your son's name is Jake, DOB: 2018-09-04. You want him in the kids program. Your DOB: 1991-04-17. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- You are signing up BOTH yourself AND your son. This is a multi-enrollee scenario.
- When asked who the class is for, say it's for both you AND your son.
- For yourself: you want BJJ / jiu-jitsu. Your DOB is April 17, 1991.
- For your son Jake: combined kids program, age 8. His DOB is September 4, 2018.
- When asked for names, give yours and Jake's full names.
- When asked for your DOB, give April 17, 1991. When asked for Jake's DOB, give September 4, 2018.
- When asked for email, give {{email}}.
- When asked for phone, give {{phone}}.
- You are cooperative.
- Do NOT ask about pricing.
- Once the bot confirms BOTH bookings (yours and Jake's), reply with [END]. If only one booking is confirmed and the bot moves on without booking the other, still reply [END] but the test will flag the missing booking.
